name: mcp-iris
description: Explore IRIS schemas/tables and run read-only SQL and vector search against your own IRIS instance.
long_description:
A reference Model Context Protocol server for InterSystems IRIS.

Tools: list_schemas, list_tables, describe_table, run_query (read-only SQL only -- INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DROP/ALTER/TRUNCATE/CALL/GRANT and multi-statement payloads are rejected before they reach IRIS), and vector_search (IRIS native VECTOR_COSINE similarity search).

Connects directly, over your own network, to an IRIS instance you already run and control -- no data passes through any third-party service. Provide the hostname/port/namespace/credentials for that instance below.

This is a community reference implementation, not an InterSystems product. See PUBLISHING.md in the source repository for why an InterSystems-owned submission would more likely ship AI Hub's own `iris-mcp-server` instead of this one.

tools.name: list_schemas
tools.description: List every SQL schema visible in the connected IRIS namespace.

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: List tables (and views), optionally filtered to one schema.

tools.name: describe_table
tools.description: List columns, types, and nullability for one table.

tools.name: run_query
tools.description: Execute a single read-only SQL statement (SELECT, or WITH ... SELECT).

tools.name: vector_search
tools.description: Top-K cosine similarity search over a VECTOR column using IRIS's native VECTOR_COSINE/TO_VECTOR.

iris_hostname.title: IRIS Hostname
iris_hostname.description: Hostname or IP of your IRIS instance's superserver.

iris_username.title: IRIS Username
iris_username.description: Use an account with read-only SQL privileges, not _SYSTEM, for anything beyond local testing.

iris_password.title: IRIS Password
iris_password.description: Password for the IRIS account above.

query_timeout_seconds.title: Query Timeout (seconds)
query_timeout_seconds.description: Maximum wall-clock time to wait for a query to complete.
